XenotypeDef.label: Jaffa
XenotypeDef.description: Jaffa are an inheritable modified human lineage adapted to undergo the Prim'ta and carry an immature Goa'uld symbiote. Children inherit the Jaffa lineage without automatically receiving a larva. Their inherited baseline remains intentionally modest; the stronger immune, healing and longevity benefits appear only while the Prim'ta health state is present.
XenotypeDef.descriptionShort: An inheritable modified human lineage adapted to undergo the Prim'ta.
